# Limitations

Our claim is scoped to Gemma~3 270M, the PT+affine Gemma Scope~2 CLT
dictionary, occupation \(a\)/\(an\) prompts, and the interventions we
ran. We did not isolate a pure context concept \(A\), nor run dedicated
latent noun-identity probes that would separate a latent
plan-then-abandon story from a package-reset story beyond executed
tokens and coarse set means.
Stage~XVIII tests one standard hint-contrast residual construction at
MLP-in layers; other dense sites remain possible in principle. Scale and
model-family generalization are outside our local compute envelope.
Affine skip means sparse interventions need not exhaust MLP computation;
the residual null reduces but does not metaphysically eliminate that
concern for every conceivable patch.
